describe.description: The image shows a single quadrupedal creature in three-quarter side view facing right against a plain off-white background. It has a broad, flat, pale pink head with a blunt snout, large round eyes and a slightly upturned mouth, with six feathery reddish-brown external gills protruding from behind the head. Its arched back and the dorsal side of its long thick tail are covered in overlapping large brown keratinous scales, while its underside, sides, and four stout limbs are covered in pale pink, moist-looking, heavily wrinkled skin with transverse folds. It stands on four short thick legs with splayed clawed feet, the tail extending to the left out of the frame.

describe.description: A stout four-legged creature shown in three-quarter view facing right. It has pale pink moist-looking wrinkled skin on the head, neck, sides, underside and limbs, with a broad flat rounded snout, large prominent eyes, small nostrils and a slight smiling mouth. Feathery reddish external gills protrude from the sides of the head and neck. The arched back, upper sides and top of the rear are covered in dense overlapping large brown scales. It stands on four short sturdy limbs ending in broad splayed clawed feet, and has a thick tapering tail extending to the left rear and partially out of frame.
